title: Design System: Crossroads Custom Apparel — The Manifest Line

shadows.name: console
shadows.purpose: Default panel elevation — a tight near-black contact shadow plus a soft wide falloff. Applied by .console-panel.

shadows.name: console-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover-lift depth on interactive panels/rows (.console-panel-interactive, shadow-console-hover).

shadows.name: glow-cyan
shadows.purpose: Primary-action glow at rest→hover (buttons, the login card).

shadows.name: glow-cyan-sm
shadows.purpose: Primary-action glow at rest, before hover deepens it.

shadows.name: glow-amber
shadows.purpose: Urgency-state panel emphasis (.console-panel-glow-amber, e.g. the unfulfilled-orders alert).

shadows.name: nav-rail-glow
shadows.purpose: The sidebar's one signature glow — the active route's left rail.

overlayScale.purpose: White-alpha overlays used throughout for borders, dividers, hover fills, and the sheen sweep, graduated by emphasis rather than enumerated as named colors: 0.03/0.04 (subtle fill), 0.06 (default border/divider), 0.08 (panel border), 0.10 (hover fill / skeleton highlight), 0.14 (hover border), 0.22 (sheen highlight peak).

motion.name: expo-out
motion.purpose: Standard entrance easing for every staggered reveal on rebuilt surfaces.

motion.name: signal-pulse
motion.purpose: The one reserved glow — a KPI icon ring pulsing only while it reports real, current urgency.

components.name: Console Panel
components.description: The base dark surface for every grouped block of content — KPI tile, order manifest, quick actions.
components.css: .ds-console-panel { background:#12151b; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius:0.5rem; color:#e3e5e9; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one interactive accent — cyan fill, near-black text for contrast, no gradient or shine sweep.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#33e1ff; color:#0a0c10; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',Inter,sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:0.875rem; padding:0.5rem 1rem; border:none; border-radius:0.375rem; cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#a7f3ff; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #33e1ff; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action on the console canvas.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color:#c3c7d0; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',Inter,sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:0.875rem; padding:0.5rem 1rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius:0.375rem; cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.20); }

components.name: Signal Lamp
components.description: Status indicator — a colored dot plus its label, never a filled pill. Exactly four states, each one real meaning.

narrative.overview: The app reads as a live dispatch floor, not a SaaS analytics skin: every order is a manifest line moving from pick to pack to ship. Near-black graphite panels stand in for a night dispatch bay; a locked set of four signal colors (cyan for primary/live, green for fulfilled, amber for overdue, red for cancelled) carries every meaningful state. Rev. 2 (user-directed) adds real layered depth: gradient panels, true two-layer shadows, signal-colored glow on primary actions and emphasis panels, two slow ambient glow fields drifting behind every canvas, hover-lift everywhere interactive, and a one-time sheen sweep on primary buttons. Content fills the viewport (max-w-1800px, centered) instead of a narrow left-hugging column. Applies across the whole app now, not just the dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black graphite grounds, never pure white cards
Exactly four state signal colors, each meaning one real thing
Real layered depth — gradient panels, true shadows, glow on emphasis surfaces, hover-lift everywhere
Two slow ambient glow fields behind every canvas — the 'alive' feeling
IBM Plex Mono for all data; IBM Plex Sans for everything else
Sharp, small radii (6–8px) — engineered, not bubbly
Content fills the viewport at full screen — no dead space
One motion grammar: staggered exponential-ease-out, hover-lift, reserved lamp-pulse, one-time sheen on primary actions

rules.name: The Locked Palette Rule
rules.body: A signal color never appears for decoration — only to report the specific state it's assigned to.

rules.name: The Graphite-300 Floor Rule
rules.body: On the graphite-950 canvas, no real text drops below graphite-300 (≈7.5:1 contrast); graphite-400 is icon-only, never text.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Data Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono is reserved for numbers, dates, IDs, and status words — never a heading or a sentence.

rules.name: The Earned Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow and gradient are the default now, but every use still answers to something real: a primary action, a panel reporting genuine urgency, or the app's own ambient 'alive' fields — never sprinkled on for its own sake.

dos: Do keep every signal color tied to its one real meaning
Do render all data in IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums
Do use graphite-300 or lighter for any real reading text on the dark canvas
donts: Don't reintroduce gradients, glassmorphism, or the btn-shine sweep on any surface built in this system
Don't add a fifth accent color
Don't delete the legacy tokens/classes/components still used by unbuilt routes
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right accent above 1px on any panel or row
